sheets.prompt: Interior concept art for a science fiction exploration game: a tall round well in the makers' foundations, blue-grey stone blocks, bundles of ancient cable climbing its walls. Two pale riding discs rise up it; on a ledge high up a brass horn on a stand, its ring the colour of the low note. On the floor a big low singing stone, just splashed and humming deep rings of sound up toward the horn, and beside it a smaller high stone, silent. A cloaked adult human traveller of ordinary height with a round jade fluid backpack rides the first disc upward, dwarfed by the well. Faint coloured light from the market's signs far above. Moebius science-fiction, Franco-Belgian ligne claire, exquisite fine pen contours, sparse delicate hatching only in shadows, luminous flat pastel gouache colours, blue-grey stone, brass, coral light, teal glints, deep blue shadows, restrained cream paper grain, clear readable construction, no lettering. Avoid: photorealism, 3d render, text, watermark, lettering, labels.
